Application Data.NAME: Smith & Co. Stationery Supplies
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Co. Stationery Supplies specializes in the retail of a wide range of stationery and paper products, including office supplies, notebooks, writing instruments, craft materials, and educational resources. Our operations include sourcing high-quality items from reputable manufacturers and distributing them through our store located at 1234 Paper Lane, Anytown, NY. We prioritize customer satisfaction by ensuring product quality and compliance with safety regulations. Regular inventory checks and meticulous product inspections help us mitigate risks associated with hidden defects. Additionally, we have implemented a returns policy to manage customer concerns effectively.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a loss occurred due to water damage from a burst pipe, resulting in inventory damage estimated at $3,000. The claim was filed, and the status is currently in process. On September 10, 2023, another incident involved a customer slip and fall due to a wet floor, leading to a settlement of $2,000. This claim has been resolved and marked as closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Medium-duty commercial safe, Class B, UL listed.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security system with video surveillance, perimeter fencing, and regular security patrols during closed hours.

3.105
Supermarkets & Grocery Stores
Underwriting Appetite
Our underwriting appetite for supermarkets and grocery stores is
guided by the size, operational complexity, and risk management practices of the business. The
following classifications provide clarity on preferred, acceptable, and non-acceptable risks:
• Preferred:
– Supermarkets with a minimum retail space of 3,000 square feet, demonstrating robust
risk management programs including regular safety audits and documented compliance
with local health and safety regulations.
